name: conclusia
description: conclusia builds and maintains company lists: target lists, market longlists, add-on candidates. Use it whenever the user wants a list of companies built, asks what lists they have, or wants a list filtered, researched or exported to Excel - and whenever they mention conclusia. It works on the user's own conclusia account.

interface.longDescription: conclusia builds and maintains company lists: target lists, market longlists, add-on candidates. Use it whenever the user wants a list of companies built, asks what lists they have, or wants a list filtered, researched or exported to Excel - and whenever they mention conclusia. Behind the endpoint works conclusia's own autonomous system: it turns a brief into explicit criteria, pulls candidates from a base of millions of active companies, and validates each one with live web evidence. It works on the user's own conclusia account.
